memories.content: The HubSpot deals export omits rows whose region field is empty; filter on region before summing.
Priya prefers the weekly summary as short bullet points.
The office printer on floor 2 needs the manual feed for A3 paper.

run.objective: Reconcile last week's closed deals into the Sales tracking sheet.
run.outcomeSummary: Filtered 3 deals with an empty region out of the HubSpot export, appended the summary row to the Sales tab, and posted a three-bullet summary to #sales-ops.

note: The run's actions name the connector and the filter the first memory describes, and the summary took the second's form. Pins USED_T.
